title: Repository migration
description: A bounded structural recipe. The pinned Objective supplies substantive acceptance, command and source authority. Confirm concrete inventory before expansion; unknown workload and cost remain unknown. Shared interfaces or metadata needing one owner must be settled through ordinary independently reviewed work before consumers.

memoryInputs.query: Repository migration prior failures corrections and interface decisions

stages.title: Confirm the immutable affected inventory
stages.goal: Enumerate the admitted current scope completely; retain complete path, blob and source identities before defining concrete work.
nonGoals: Do not widen Objective acceptance, authorized sources, commands, permissions or admitted resources.

stages.title: Apply the Objective change to one confirmed batch
stages.goal: Implement the specified migration for this authenticated batch; preserve shared interfaces and unchanged behavior, and author its relevant integration tests/documentation under concrete ownership.
nonGoals: Do not widen Objective acceptance, authorized sources, commands, permissions or admitted resources.

stages.title: Verify every original Objective criterion
stages.goal: Review the complete integrated result using current source-authorized evidence, including empty-inventory outcomes; discovery and historical guidance are not acceptance proof.
nonGoals: Do not widen Objective acceptance, authorized sources, commands, permissions or admitted resources.
